emails.subject: Your Cascade Mutual claim CM-4471820 has been opened
emails.body: Hello, this is Ramona Beaulieu, the field adjuster assigned to claim CM-4471820 for the burst-pipe water damage at 18 Alder Court. To keep your claim moving I need clear photos of every damaged area, gathered in one place before your inspection. Please note your $850 deductible applies to this claim. You can reach me by reply or at 5550183001. Regards, Ramona Beaulieu, Cascade Mutual Insurance.

emails.subject: Claim CM-4471820 - inspection scheduled
emails.body: Confirming your on-site inspection for Tuesday the 12th at 9:30 AM. Please have all of your damage photos gathered before I arrive so we can walk through them room by room. Regards, Ramona Beaulieu, Cascade Mutual Insurance.
